audit_mode: CPU/deterministic read-only repository audit; no model execution

notes: Legacy E2 and L3/W6b are selected by different planner classes and are mutually exclusive within one run.
Citation-density/section regeneration is default-active on the fast Chat path; critic, self-verify, W7 recovery, and L4 reflection recovery are default-off.
Low-level tool retry can hide up to three dispatch attempts inside one agent step but is counted as call amplification, not a reflection owner.

fast_chat_path: citation-density or section-coverage regeneration, maximum one
agent_path: planner factory selects exactly one of legacy E2, L3/W6b, or thorough-read execution
prepare_agent_generation reloads and gates step chunks
critic failure may directly retrieve, regenerate, and re-critic once
critical_boundary_findings: Fast Chat critic runs before a later content mutation, so it does not certify the final answer.
Agent critic-directed retrieval occurs after AgentRunOutcome formation and is absent from outcome.steps, EvidenceState, normal step audit, and retrieval duration accounting.
prepare_agent_generation receives AgentRunOutcome but currently discards it, so terminal/refuse/clarify and low_confidence do not directly govern generation.
Fast-cache hits can bypass critic and the cache key does not isolate critic/self-verify settings.

mechanisms.trigger: low recall or a first-round complex query on the LLMPlanner path
mechanisms.input: query, tool observations, remaining agent budget
mechanisms.output: query rewrite or decomposed sub-query search plan
mechanisms.retry_or_replan: rewrite/decompose, optional drift recovery, evidence-insufficiency recovery, or LLM replan after failure
mechanisms.budget_owner: shared steps_used/max_steps plus agent_max_reflections; rewrite/decompose LLM calls are not agent steps
mechanisms.failure_semantics: bounded but nested recovery can amplify LLM/tool calls; unchanged rewrites may consume reflection budget

mechanisms.trigger: NextActionPlanner observations, tool failures, missing FactGoals, low recall, or conflict
mechanisms.output: finish, retrieve, fill-gap, fallback, clarify, or refuse decision
mechanisms.retry_or_replan: each observation returns to the same bounded loop
mechanisms.failure_semantics: W6b reflection reason/count lacks a dedicated structured audit event

mechanisms.retry_or_replan: may request another retrieval while shared budget remains
mechanisms.failure_semantics: retrieval sufficiency is not claim/evidence semantic support; original_query is not used by the sufficiency calculation

mechanisms.input: EvidenceState conflict flags and remaining reflection budget
mechanisms.output: W6 proposes retrieval, then StopPolicy may replace it with refuse
audit_and_tests: separate W6 and StopPolicy tests; no three-flag integration test
mechanisms.failure_semantics: with all three flags enabled, StopPolicy makes the W6 conflict recovery branch unreachable

mechanisms.trigger: retryable exception or classified tool failure
mechanisms.input: one planned tool step and failure classification
mechanisms.output: retried dispatch, equivalent fallback, or replanned tool
mechanisms.retry_or_replan: initial dispatch plus up to two retry attempts; at most two tool replans
mechanisms.budget_owner: one visible agent step for internal retries; replanned/fallback steps use shared step budget
mechanisms.failure_semantics: per-attempt dispatch is not individually represented in steps, budget hooks, or tool audit

mechanisms.deterministic_owned: citation presence/range and shallow lexical overlap rules
mechanisms.retry_or_replan: LLM verification failure can produce a corrected answer
mechanisms.budget_owner: critic claim cap; no shared runtime reflection budget
mechanisms.failure_semantics: refusal or empty chunks can pass; shallow overlap can miss wrong evidence; max-claim truncation has no unevaluated signal

mechanisms.input: whole answer and at most five truncated chunks
mechanisms.output: binary verified flag and optional corrected answer
mechanisms.retry_or_replan: one correction generation on verification failure; correction is not reverified here
mechanisms.budget_owner: independent generation helper, not shared agent steps
mechanisms.failure_semantics: missing key, invalid JSON, missing verified field, or exception can fail open; future contract maps this to UNVERIFIABLE/degraded

mechanisms.trigger: citation density or section coverage check after critic/self-verify
mechanisms.input: already verified draft and retrieved chunks
mechanisms.budget_owner: generation-local maximum, not agent reflection budget
mechanisms.failure_semantics: final content may differ from the content inspected by critic and safety

mechanisms.input: failed CriticResult, original outcome steps, gated chunks
mechanisms.output: one direct semantic search, merged chunks, regenerated answer, and second critic result
mechanisms.retry_or_replan: retrieve then revise then re-critic once
mechanisms.budget_owner: local CRITIC_RETRIEVAL_MAX=1 check against original steps_used; recovery does not increment outcome steps
mechanisms.failure_semantics: recovery search is absent from outcome.steps, EvidenceState, DB step/audit, retrieval_duration_ms, and shared budget accounting
outcome is discarded; chunk reload verifies document/kb relation but relies on upstream scope enforcement

ordered_pipeline: scoped retrieval/runtime correction under shared agent budget
freeze the exact prompt-visible evidence snapshot
run semantic claim-evidence critic only for eligible claims
return one bounded advisory action to the outer orchestration owner
if a single explicitly budgeted revision occurs, pass it through the same deterministic and semantic boundary once
target_reflection_architecture.legal_evidence_boundary: The critic consumes only the same-run AgentGenerationPlan.gated_chunks and synchronized citations, with optional read-only same-run EvidenceState metadata. It must never reload arbitrary chunk identifiers or broaden scope.
target_reflection_architecture.no_parallel_critic: Harden or replace the existing generation critic path; do not add a second independent reflection/revision loop.

stop_conditions_triggered: An existing critic is already integrated in both Chat and Agent generation paths.
Agent generation already contains a retrieve-revise-recritic loop with incomplete budget/provenance accounting.
Chat generation can mutate content after critic/self-verification.
Current fail-open verification cannot support a product experiment without semantic degraded-state handling.
Cache/settings isolation and final-output boundary are not yet contract-safe.
